# VOX fixtures

The Phase 1 fixture corpus is original test data generated in source by
`tests/test_vox_phase1.py` and `tools/benchmark_vox.py`; it contains no
third-party or game-derived content. It covers multi-model `PACK` files, RGBA and
material metadata, layers, named scene graphs, transforms, hidden layers, corrupt
input bounds, and a 100k-voxel benchmark proxy.
